prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: EXT. CITY ARTERIAL ROAD. A wide, multi-lane contemporary city arterial road at dusk, seen from a raised vantage. Back side: the road runs straight away from the camera to a vanishing point between glass office towers, under a deep blue and orange dusk sky. Left side: a row of tall glass office towers with lit windows above a tree-lined sidewalk and a line of streetlights. Right side: a matching row of towers and streetlights. Front side, behind the camera: the overpass the view is taken from. The lanes are packed with traffic, white headlights coming towards the camera and red tail-lights going away. Light comes from the dusk sky, the streetlamps flickering on along both sides, and the headlights.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
